newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan pinball lovers arrested in daughter's death.
newsitem.headline: Japan pinball lovers arrested in daughter's death.

text.p: Japanese police said on Friday they arrested a couple suspected of killing their two-year-old daughter by confining her to a dresser drawer while the pair went to play "pachinko," a Japanese pinball game.

As punishment for disobeying her parents, the girl was pushed into the drawer of a small dresser while the mother and father went out to a pachinko parlour, said a police spokesman in Kagawa prefecture in western Japan.
When the couple returned home several hours later, they found their daughter dead, the spokesman said.
Pachinko, a cacophonous slot-machine and pinball hybrid, boasts 30 million players across Japan.
In Japan, where most forms of gambling are illegal, pachinko straddles a legal grey zone as winning players can trade in token prizes such as sweets or cigarette lighters for cash.
